decisions.primary_representation: global mean over all tokens (object-window pooling = secondary)
decisions.precision: fp32 (bf16 rejected: 1.0-1.75% rel. error per block, see reports/gate0.md)
decisions.primary_layers: hierarchical taps blocks {5,11,17,23} after their own norms_block; all 24 raw block outputs exploratory
decisions.primary_hypothesis: H2 cross-context gravity alignment, compared against the tracked-trajectory baseline

delta_rule: delta_g fixed across scenarios (same intervention in every context); delta_e and delta_mu chosen so peak trajectory displacement between +/- variants matches that of delta_g inside the same scenario (dev worlds, medians: bounce g 0.175 m, e(0.05)=0.224 m -> 0.04; incline g 0.148 m, mu(0.025)=0.204 m -> 0.02)
split: per primary scenario 5 development + 5 held-out worlds; nuisance and composition worlds split 5/5 as well
